notes.subject: לץ
notes.rationale: Hebrew 'one who makes mouths at' (scoffer); rendered as Tok Pisin mocker phrase, literal mouth-mocking picture lost

notes.subject: ואין
notes.rationale: Hebrew says 'and it is not' — a pure nonexistence word; rendered as 'does not find it' plus bracketed ⟨i no gat⟩

translation: Man i baikim tupla het i lukautim hatkamap tok bilong ol gutpela man, tasol em i no painim; na save long man i save skelim, em i kamap isi.
